title: A swinging dance-band William Tell, played for Hal Kemp
summary: The WPA dance band played Randolph's swing arrangement of William Tell, which Hal Kemp came to hear at noon.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Played so much trombone. And, well, I played such arrangements, like William Tell, I had Hal Kemp to come over -- I played a school and I had Hal Kemp to come way over -- he was playing in the city, and you know Hal Kemp's band.
Yeah, well, he came over there to hear the band one noon, before the program. And so we played for him William Tell.
Well, was it a concert band or a
Dance band. And you had a dance band arrangement of the William Tell Overture?
Yeah, I didn't have time to fool around with nothing -- with no concert music.
I was swinging. I had William Tell practically from start to finish. But it was swinging all the way.
Do you have any of those scores left? Did you keep any of that stuff?
I'd have to look down in the basement to see if I have one of those scores.
